description: This file implements a specialized Large Language Model (LLM) service for the Pipecat project, integrating OpenPipe's API with the existing OpenAI LLM interface to enable fine-tuning, monitoring, and enhanced request logging within the Pipecat architecture.

classes.name: OpenPipeLLMService
classes.description: An extension of the OpenAILLMService that integrates with OpenPipe's API, adding functionality for request tagging and logging specific to OpenPipe.

methods.description: Initializes the OpenPipeLLMService with specific parameters such as model name, API keys, URLs, and tags, and passes them to the superclass constructor.

methods.description: Creates and configures an OpenPipe API client instance using provided or default API keys and URLs.

methods.description: Builds request parameters for chat completion, extending the base parameters with OpenPipe-specific fields for logging and tagging.
